mapper.select: SELECT /* getWelcomePageList */ WLCM_NUMB , VERS_NUMB , CASE WHEN #{englishYsno} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(SUBX_ENTL, ''), SUBX_TITL) ELSE SUBX_TITL END AS SUBX_TITL , CASE WHEN #{englishYsno} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(MAIN_ENTL, ''), MAIN_TITL) ELSE MAIN_TITL END AS MAIN_TITL , CASE WHEN #{englishYsno} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(PAGE_ENCT, ''), PAGE_DESC) ELSE PAGE_DESC END AS PAGE_DESC , CASE WHEN #{englishYsno} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(IMGE_ENUR, ''), IMGE_URLX) ELSE IMGE_URLX END AS IMGE_URLX , SORT_ORDR FROM CT_WLCMPG WHERE DPLY_YSNO = #{yes} ORDER BY SORT_ORDR , WLCM_NUMB
